name: in-outer-projection-materialized-input
sql: WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT k,x FROM inner_rows WHERE enabled=1) SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+1 IN (SELECT c.x+o.k FROM c WHERE c.k=o.k) ORDER BY o.id;

name: in-outer-projection-derived-values
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+1 IN (SELECT i.column2+o.k FROM (VALUES (1,10),(1,10),(1,NULL),(2,20),(NULL,30),(4,50)) AS i WHERE i.column1=o.k) ORDER BY o.id;

name: not-in-outer-projection-materialized-input
sql: WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT k,x FROM inner_rows WHERE enabled=1) SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+1 NOT IN (SELECT c.x+o.k FROM c WHERE c.k=o.k) ORDER BY o.id;

name: not-in-outer-projection-derived-values
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+1 NOT IN (SELECT i.column2+o.k FROM (VALUES (1,10),(1,10),(1,NULL),(2,20),(NULL,30),(4,50)) AS i WHERE i.column1=o.k) ORDER BY o.id;
